near_misses.detail: 3BR at S$2,000,000 but 990 sqft (fails >1,000 sqft floor) and TOP Nov 2027 (uncompleted new project, fails built-2000+ and exclude-new-launch)

data_quality_notes: All portal search + listing pages (PropertyGuru, 99.co, EdgeProp), iproperty, and PropNex returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on live fetch this run.
No individual listing URL could be opened/verified live, so no listing is output (hard rule: never output a listing without a verified link).
Candidate details visible only via search-engine indexed snippets, which are NOT a live retrieval from the source and cannot substitute for a verified URL.
New hard filter this run vs 2026-06-06 baseline: minimum 3 bedrooms. The baseline's Bliss @ Kovan (2BR penthouse) and Flamingo Valley (2BR) would now fail the bedroom filter regardless of price/size.
No PSF below 1,700 ceiling could be confirmed for any in-district freehold 3BR unit this run.
